author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices a five-note scale, long-short rhythm, same words with a new tune, octaves and two-hand teamwork, with the old Scottish friendship song.

classes.title: Five notes, two left out
classes.goal: Find the hand's place and notice the song uses only C, D, E, G and A.

mathTarget.parentLine: This tune uses only five keys and skips two

classes.parentPrompt: Help the thumb find C left of the two black keys, then point to F and B: skipped.
classes.childAction: Find C, then play only the song's five keys: C, D, E, G, A.
classes.bridge: F and B are asleep today; the tune tiptoes past them and never wakes them.

intro.caption: Five keys, two are asleep
intro.parentCue: point to F and B: today we skip them

games.caption: The song's five keys
games.parentCue: Point to each key and say its name

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: finding the song's five keys and skipping two.

classes.title: Climb to the top
classes.goal: Play 'and never brought to mind', which climbs up to high A and rests.

mathTarget.parentLine: The tune climbs to its highest note and rests there

classes.parentPrompt: Raise your hand slowly as the tune climbs; hold it high on the long A.
classes.childAction: Play the line and hold high A for three long beats.
classes.bridge: Moving right is climbing a hill; the long A is the view from the top.

intro.caption: Climb up the hill
intro.parentCue: raise your hand as the tune climbs

games.caption: And never brought to mind
games.parentCue: Count the long A: one, two, three

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a tune that climbs to its top note.

classes.title: Same words, new tune
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and notice lines 1 and 3 share words but not notes.

mathTarget.parentLine: Same words, but the tune starts in a new place

classes.parentPrompt: When 'Should auld acquaintance' comes back, ask: same notes or new ones? Sing stuck words.
classes.childAction: Play slowly and spot the line that comes back with new notes.
classes.bridge: Line 3 wears the same words as line 1, but starts high instead of low.

intro.caption: Same words, are the notes the same?
intro.parentCue: ask after line 3: same or different?

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: comparing two lines with the same words.

classes.title: Lo-ong and short
classes.goal: Play the long-short notes slowly: a long note, then a quick one.

mathTarget.parentLine: One long note that lasts three times a short one

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'lo-o-ong, short' with the notes while your child plays; go slow first.
classes.childAction: Play the long-short pairs: hold, hold, hold, quick.
classes.bridge: A long note is a big slow stride; the short note, a tiny skip after.

intro.caption: Lo-o-ong, short
intro.parentCue: say it with the notes, nice and slow

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing long-short rhythms evenly.

classes.title: Low notes, same names
classes.goal: Play one low left-hand note at the start of each bar while the grown-up plays the tune.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same note name lives lower on the left

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune while your child plays the low notes. Count bars out loud: one, two, three.
classes.childAction: Play one low note with your left hand at each 'one'.
classes.bridge: The low note is the same name in a lower house, far to the left.

games.caption: Same name, lower house
games.parentCue: Point left on each low C

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing low notes with the left hand.

classes.title: One-two-three-four, low note
classes.goal: Keep the left-hand notes going at full speed, landing on each 'one'.

mathTarget.parentLine: Each bar has four beats; the low note lands on one

classes.parentPrompt: Count one-two-three-four with each bar, loud on one. Keep going if notes slip.
classes.childAction: Play your low note on every big one, then wait three beats.
classes.bridge: Four steps round the circle; the low note is the first big step.

intro.caption: Low note on one
intro.parentCue: count loud on one, soft on two, three, four

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: landing on the first beat of each bar.

classes.title: Two hands, two jobs
classes.goal: Play the tune with a low left-hand note at the start of each bar, very slowly.

mathTarget.parentLine: One low note for every four beats of tune

classes.parentPrompt: Rest a hand on your child's left shoulder and say 'low' on each bar. Go very slowly.
classes.childAction: Right hand plays the tune; left hand plays one low note each bar.
classes.bridge: The left hand is the steady floor; the right hand dances on top.

intro.caption: Two hands, two jobs
intro.parentCue: say 'low' on each bar, very slowly

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing two hands with two different jobs.

classes.title: Slow song, quicker song
classes.goal: Play both hands a little faster, and go back to slow when notes fall apart.

mathTarget.parentLine: The same song, only the speed changes

classes.parentPrompt: Listen together to slow, then quicker; go back to slow if it gets messy.
classes.childAction: Play slowly, then a bit faster, the very same notes.
classes.bridge: A slow walk and a brisk walk take the same path to the same place.

intro.caption: Same song, a little faster
intro.parentCue: go back to slow whenever needed

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping a song together at two speeds.

classes.title: Friends in a circle
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music at full speed.

mathTarget.parentLine: Keeping up with a beat that does not wait

classes.parentPrompt: Sit beside your child and nod on every one; cheer for keeping going, not for notes.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music and keep going, even after a slip.
classes.bridge: Friends in a circle sway together; nobody stops if one foot slips.

intro.caption: Sway like friends in a circle
intro.parentCue: nod on every one and smile at slips

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping up with the music together.

classes.title: Friendship concert for teddy
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy and hear how line 2 asks and line 4 lands home.

mathTarget.parentLine: One line sounds unfinished; the last one sounds like home

classes.parentPrompt: Seat teddy as the audience; after the last note, hold hands and bow together.
classes.childAction: Play for teddy, land softly on the last C, then bow.
classes.bridge: Line 2 stops high, like a question; line 4 comes home to C, like an answer.
classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: playing a whole song, start to end.
